reason: A DSH plugin that derives per-turn skill and tool usage from committed session logs and visualizes the results as badges beneath assistant replies.

summaries.zh: 从已提交的会话日志中整理每轮触发、成功或失败的技能与工具，并在助手回复下方显示徽章轨迹。
summaries.en: Derives per-turn triggered, successful, and failed skills and tools from committed session logs and displays them as badges beneath assistant replies.

capabilities: Reads committed session log tool-call and tool-result events
Projects per-turn triggered, successful, and failed skill or tool usage
Renders usage badges beneath assistant replies in the chat interface
Persists and backfills projection data through the host projection subsystem
